authority: Supabase PostgreSQL catalog pg_class, pg_namespace, pg_policies and information_schema.columns; no application data read

domainRules.interpretation: Preserve metadata for reconciliation, never import data or content across segregated domains without independent review

limitations: Column types use PostgreSQL udt_name and do not contain complete typmods/definitions
The column signature includes defaults, but raw default expressions are deliberately not exposed
This snapshot alone does not reconstruct FK, CHECK, UNIQUE, indexes, functions, views, triggers, grants, RLS policy expressions or data
Full schema reconstruction requires catalog export, dependency mapping, deterministic ordered DDL, CI validation, rollback, WO and Kernel admission
RLS enabled does not imply safe access policies
Application table count includes segregated accounting entities for inventory only
